artworks.subject: A monumental fragment of a DNA double helix curves upward along the far right like a loosely twisted sculptural ladder. Its gray and dark forest-green strands break apart at the top into three small separate arcs, suggesting mutation and possibility. Just a few rungs, asymmetry, unfinished geometry; one tiny isolated green curve near the lower left. No extra objects.
artworks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone full-bleed background artwork for an elegant minimalist Danish research consortium website. Create ONE complete landscape image, 1536 by 1024, not a contact sheet.
Style/medium: surreal modern abstract pencil drawing. Heavy, assured, pressure-varied hand-drawn pencil outlines with visible dry pencil grain, occasional double-contours and purposeful broken strokes. MINIMAL shading, essentially contour drawing. Gray graphite pencil and deep dark forest-green colored pencil ONLY; no other pigment, no black ink, no gradients, no painterly washes, no 3D rendering, no realistic cast shadows.
Backdrop: flat very pale warm ivory paper (#f5f3ed), almost smooth, no vignette or paper edges.
Composition: sparse, sophisticated, airy, with at least 75% of the image empty paper. Primary drawing is concentrated at the right edge, between 67% and 94% of the image width, and there may be one very small detached mark near bottom-left. Keep the whole left 62% and central upper region blank for website headlines. Leave empty space around every form; no dense collage. Artwork can gently run out of the right edge. Bold strokes, restrained number of marks.
Constraints: no words, no captions, no letters, no numbers, no branding, no border, no watermark. This is evocative abstract art, not a labeled scientific diagram.
Subject for this unique piece: A monumental fragment of a DNA double helix curves upward along the far right like a loosely twisted sculptural ladder. Its gray and dark forest-green strands break apart at the top into three small separate arcs, suggesting mutation and possibility. Just a few rungs, asymmetry, unfinished geometry; one tiny isolated green curve near the lower left. No extra objects.

artworks.subject: One impossible folded protein ribbon at the right: a spare dark-green loop threading through two angular gray folded contours, a floating sculptural knot that appears to unfold into a small disconnected line. Open contours and very little internal detail, not a dense molecular ball. One tiny detached gray arc at bottom-left.

artworks.subject: An abstract mathematical phase portrait at the far right: two bold incomplete gray coordinate-like planes with one dark-green looping trajectory escaping their geometry. One arc branches into three short diverging pencil paths. Suggest probability, dynamical systems, and an impossible infinity without any letters, numerals, tick labels, or written equations. A few precise marks only.

artworks.subject: Three abstract rod-shaped bacteria at the right float at different angles like minimal sculptural vessels. One dark-green rod is almost splitting into two, a second gray rod is an open capsule with a single curved inner line, a third is a smaller broken contour. One or two very spare filament strokes connect the forms in an improbable loose network. No dense internal organelles, no field of dots.

artworks.subject: A surreal stock-market chart at the right becomes a small abstract branching organism. A heavy gray jagged price trajectory rises, breaks, and continues as two dark-green alternative paths. A few spare detached candlestick-like vertical pencil marks below, no axes numbers or lettering. It must read as conceptual art rather than a dashboard or an actual data visualization; no dense grid.

artworks.subject: Two incomplete geometric virus forms hover at the right: one gray open faceted capsid drawn with a few heavy edges, one dark-green circular contour with only six sparse radial protrusions. A tiny missing facet drifts away and echoes an evolving form. Dramatic empty interior, no shading, no dense spiky ball, no clinical realism.

artworks.subject: Two surreal evolving AI bots at the far right, abstract minimal open wireframe heads rather than cute mascots. A small angular gray head with two tiny slit marks dissolves into an airy taller dark-green head built from only a few curved pencil contours. A short broken trail of three simple geometric fragments suggests variation and emergence. No faces with smiles, no circuit-board clutter, no antenna cartoon.

artworks.subject: One surreal evolutionary sequence along the right edge: a very small open gray capsule gradually unfolds into a dark-green spiral strand and then into a spare angular branching structure, the three connected by only two discontinuous strokes. It should ambiguously suggest genetic material, adaptive algorithms, and a tree of possible futures. Sculptural, abstract, modern, with no literal tree, no dense collage.
